faq.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a: No. Pick the widget, fill in the fields and paste one line into your site. If your platform lets you add an HTML code block, that is enough.

faq.q: Why a subscription and not a one-time payment?
faq.a: Because the widget lives on our servers: hosting, improvements and the changes you make from the panel are included. If you prefer the source code to host it yourself, buy the template: one-time payment and it is yours.

A section from our catalog that you configure here and that shows up on your site with one line of code, like any widget. No coding needed: you edit it from LAB and the change shows up on its own wherever you pasted it.

faq.q: Can I change the content later?
faq.a: Yes. Edit the text in LAB, hit Publish, and the change shows on your site on the next refresh. No need to touch the code again.

faq.q: Can it read data from my page?
faq.a: No. The widget runs inside an iframe on our domain. The browser isolates it: it can't reach your cookies, forms, or the rest of your page.

faq.q: Does it work on Webflow, WordPress, etc.?
faq.a: Yes, on any site where you can paste a <script> tag into the HTML.

faq.q: What happens if I unpublish or cancel the plan?
faq.a: The embed stops rendering: nothing shows where the script was. Publishing again brings it back.
Leave the list empty and the widget shows on any domain. Add domains and it only works there — so nobody else can reuse it.

faq.q: How is this different from the Builder?
faq.a: It depends on whether you already have a site. Already have one? LAB adds widgets without touching it: we host them and they update on their own. Building a new one? The Builder assembles the whole page and gives you the source code: one-time payment, it is yours.

chapters.description: Near-white raw canvas, ink type at 17vw, and a single burnt-orange accent. Restraint over spectacle. Ideal for digital magazines, writer portfolios, or editorial brands that want a long-form story page.

nocturne.description: Near-black screen, full-bleed photography, and an acid accent. The page behaves like a film, not a document. Ideal for photographers, filmmakers, fashion lookbooks, or galleries built around full-bleed imagery.

monolith.description: Concrete grey, hard 2px borders, condensed type, and a wireframe 3D monolith spinning behind the hero. Ideal for architecture studios, industrial design, or tech products that need a spec sheet and brutalist presence.

velocity.description: Deep green, lime accent, cinematic scroll: strike-exit hero, On/Off merge, helmet product grid and upward parallax — no 3D. Ideal for sports brands, outdoor gear, performance apparel, or an athlete-product ecommerce.

fizz.description: Electric blue, candy colors and a 3D glass bottle spinning through bubbles. Every flavor is a full screen that repaints the page as you scroll. Ideal for drinks, snacks, candy, or any edible product with flavors or variants to showcase.

atelier.description: Atmospheric dark canvas, scroll-tied fog, and 3D pieces that rotate or shatter as you scroll. Digital studio aesthetic. Ideal for agencies, creative studios, or architecture practices selling premium services with a prestige site.

comic.description: Paper-page comic panels, a sticky layered SVG truck scene, and a chapter rail. Ideal for narrative campaigns, NGOs, editorials, or brands that want a long scroll-told story.

unity.description: Stone canvas, Playfair body + Anton display, a photo mosaic that unfolds into a full-bleed slider, and a closer with a rising cutout. For campaigns, events, or brands that want high-impact editorial storytelling.

ratio.description: A Beat storytelling template for desktop: cube and type on a rail, plates that punch through the viewport, a stacking well, and a horizontal closer. Print-shop stock and vermillion register. Not built for mobile.

atrium.description: Bone paper, editorial serif, and generic architecture photography. The pinned hero holds a single massing shot under a typographic manifesto; a project index, a pinned process, and a black ring of studio photos set the pace before the practice figures. Ideal for architecture studios, real estate developers, or any practice that wants to show its work at this scale of type.

meridian.description: Warm sand, editorial serif, and an aerial flythrough that plays as you scroll: a frame-sequence hero whose logo docks into the header, a drawer menu, a full-screen slider with a mask transition, a map whose pins trace dotted routes, and interior photos with hotspots that open tooltips. Ideal for real estate developments, cabin complexes, apartment or condo buildings, developers and builders with several complexes to showcase, or resorts.

kin.description: Cool paper, ink and a single red. The brand is a word built from identical bars: they drop like type in the loader, come apart into a doorway the camera walks through into a dark room, and set themselves again in the footer. A pinned collection where a triptych folds into a stack of works in depth, with a bar counter and grain. Made for art, fashion or design galleries, studios and product brands with a strong identity.

fold.description: A paper world told as a film: thousands of frames on one canvas that move with every tick of the scroll, with no cuts and no still pictures. The camera circles a sphere under construction that opens like a flower, drops into a town at night, flies into the moon as it folds into a workshop and comes out at dawn. A hairline grid reframes every shot, text cards arrive on cue, dots and paper-tear transitions, a chapter rail with a full-screen menu and a looping footer. Ships with the script that builds the film from your own clips. Made for brands that tell a story: launches, products, studios.
fold.notice: The film in the demo is a sample: for your brand you will need to produce your own video clips (AI-generated or shot), and that is most of the work. The ZIP ships the engine, the script that turns your clips into the film and a step-by-step guide. If you would rather have us do it, our Studio adapts it to your brand.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how {{site}} collects, uses, and protects your data when you visit the site, sign in, make a purchase, download a product, or write to us about a Studio project.

sections.title: Data we collect
items: Google account data: identifier, name, email address, and profile picture when you choose to sign in with Google.
Purchase and order data: products, amount, currency, payment status, Mercado Pago or Paddle identifiers (depending on how you pay), and download count.
Basic technical data needed to operate and protect the service, such as IP address, browser, server logs, and session cookies.
The welcome coupon we give you when you create your account: your email address, when you received it, which channel you came from (if you arrived through a tagged link) and whether you used it.
If you write to us through the contact or Studio form: your name, email, message, and the project type you selected.

sections.title: How we use your data
items: Create and manage your account and keep you signed in.
Process payments, confirm orders, and enable downloads.
Send receipts and operational messages related to your purchases.
Email you the welcome coupon for your first purchase. We do not send newsletters.
Reply to you when you write through the contact form, including Studio (bespoke work) inquiries.
Prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access, and comply with legal obligations.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body: We use Google for authentication, Mercado Pago to process payments from Argentina in pesos and Paddle.com, our online reseller (Merchant of Record), for payments from other countries in US dollars: Paddle receives your name, email, country and payment details to charge you, issue the invoice and calculate taxes, and handles that data under its own privacy policy (paddle.com/legal/privacy), Formspree to receive contact-form messages, Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics to understand aggregate site usage, and email providers to send receipts and coupons. These providers handle data under their own privacy policies. We do not receive or store your complete card details.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use a session cookie to keep your account authenticated. Google Tag Manager and Analytics may set their own cookies to measure aggregate visits. We may also store preferences such as language, theme, cart, and builder compositions in your browser. You can delete this data through your browser settings, although some features may stop working correctly.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.body: We retain data for as long as needed to provide the service, maintain purchase history, prevent fraud, and meet legal or accounting obligations. We apply reasonable security measures, but no system can guarantee absolute protection.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data, and revoke Google access from your Google account. Some order information may be retained where legally required. To exercise your rights, email us at the address below.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy to reflect service changes or legal requirements. The current version and effective date will always be posted on this page.

sections.title: Hosted components (LAB)
items: When you publish an instance we store its configuration (text and allowed domains) tied to your account. It is deleted when you delete the instance or your account.

The <script> you add to your site loads content from our domain. In doing so, our server and CDN log technical request data (IP, user-agent, referer) to operate the service, prevent abuse, and measure usage in aggregate.
The embed runs isolated in an iframe: it does not read cookies, forms, or content of the page it is embedded in, and we do not share your visitors data with third parties.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of {{site}}. By accessing the site, creating an account, or purchasing a product, you agree to these conditions.

sections.title: Account and access
sections.body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and for activity performed through it. You must provide accurate information and must not share your credentials or download links.

sections.title: Products and license
sections.body: Products are digital source-code downloads: fixed models (CHAPTERS, NOCTURNE, MONOLITH, VELOCITY, FIZZ, ATELIER), builder compositions, and—if you add it—the Commerce kit (catalog, product page, cart, and checkout). A purchase does not transfer intellectual property ownership; it only grants the usage rights in the Regular License published on the site. The ZIP includes your license with email and order number.

sections.title: Prices and payments
sections.body: Current prices are shown in the catalog and builder. If you pay from Argentina, the payment is processed by Mercado Pago in Argentine pesos: the total is the one shown when you pay, subject to their approval, and an order is considered paid when Mercado Pago confirms the payment. If you pay from any other country, our order process is conducted by our online reseller Paddle.com, which is the Merchant of Record for those orders: it charges in US dollars, issues the invoice, applies any taxes due in your country and handles billing inquiries. In that case an order is considered paid when Paddle confirms the payment, and the purchase is also governed by Paddle’s checkout buyer terms (paddle.com/legal/checkout-buyer-terms). Welcome coupon: new accounts get 10% off their first purchase of templates, the bundle or builder compositions, once, with the Google account they signed up with. It’s applied automatically at checkout and doesn’t stack: the second purchase and later ones are at list price, and a refunded purchase counts as a purchase. It doesn’t apply to LAB subscriptions.

sections.title: Delivery and downloads
sections.body: After payment is confirmed, the product becomes available under My purchases so you can download it whenever you want. You are responsible for backing up the files. We may limit or block downloads where fraud, abuse, or a breach is suspected.

sections.title: Refunds
sections.body: Templates, bundle and builder: you can ask for a full refund within {{days}} calendar days of purchase, for any reason, as long as you haven’t downloaded the ZIP. LAB: you can ask for a refund of the first charge within {{days}} days of subscribing (the free trial counts toward it), and the subscription ends right away; renewals aren’t refunded and canceling stops future charges. If you already downloaded the ZIP, a refund is only available if the file can’t be opened or delivered, has a substantial technical defect or isn’t as described, or if applicable law requires it. Scope, what is returned and how to ask are in the Refund policy. An approved refund goes back to the original payment method (Mercado Pago or Paddle) and the license and downloads for that order are revoked. To request it, use the Withdrawal request button at the bottom of the home page.

sections.title: Permitted use
sections.body: You may not use the service to infringe third-party rights, compromise systems, automate abusive downloads, resell source files, or conduct illegal activity. We may suspend access if we detect a breach.

sections.title: Availability and liability
sections.body: We aim to keep the service available and products functional, but do not guarantee uninterrupted operation or compatibility with every environment. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages or losses arising from use or inability to use the service.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update the service and these Terms. The current version and effective date will be posted on this page. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

sections.title: Studio (bespoke work)
items: Custom sites, adapting a model, and maintenance and support are quote-based services: they are not purchased from the catalog or paid through Mercado Pago inside the site. Price and scope are agreed before starting, case by case.

We do not guarantee business results (more clients, more sales, more conversion): we build and deliver the site at the quality level you see in our models; business results depend on factors we don't control, like marketing or traffic.

On a custom site (built from scratch), ownership of the final result is yours once the agreed payment is completed: it's work made for hire. Adapting a model stays under the Regular License, since it starts from one of our templates.
Payment, timelines, deliverables, and cancellation terms for each Studio project are set out in that project's specific agreement, not in these Terms or the Regular License.

sections.title: Hosted components (LAB)
items: The LAB service displays a section you configure, served from our infrastructure through a <script> you add to your site. It is an ongoing subscription service, not a deliverable product.
The component code stays hosted by us: it is not licensed or delivered to you. To get the source code, use the Builder and the ZIP download.

The subscription is billed in advance (monthly or yearly) through Mercado Pago in Argentine pesos or, if you pay from another country, through Paddle.com in US dollars as our authorized reseller; it renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel.

You can cancel anytime from My account. Cancellation stops future renewals and you keep access until the end of the period already paid. Each charge can be refunded within {{days}} days under the Refund policy; after that period, amounts already charged are non-refundable unless applicable law requires otherwise.

If you unpublish the instance, cancel the subscription, or we suspend/revoke it for breach or non-payment, the embed stops rendering on your site. When the subscription lapses, sections published beyond the plan limit also stop showing.
Prices may change. We will give reasonable advance notice and the new price applies from the following period.
We make reasonable efforts to keep the service available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted availability and are not liable for losses from downtime, latency, or changes to the service.

Acceptable use: you may not use the embed for illegal or deceptive content, content that infringes third-party rights, or to load the service abusively. We may suspend or revoke a non-compliant instance.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.intro: This is when and how we give your money back. It covers the templates, the bundle, builder compositions and LAB subscriptions from {{site}}, whether you pay with Mercado Pago or by card (Paddle).

sections.title: Refund period
items: Templates, bundle and builder: full refund within {{days}} calendar days of purchase, for any reason, as long as you haven’t downloaded the ZIP.

LAB: the period is {{days}} calendar days from when you subscribe, free trial included. Nothing is charged during the trial (cancel and you pay nothing); within that period you can ask for a full refund of the first charge and the subscription ends right away. Renewals aren’t refunded.

sections.title: If you already downloaded the ZIP
sections.body: Once downloaded, the code is in your hands and there is no change-of-mind refund. We do give your money back, within the same period, if the file can’t be opened or delivered, has a substantial technical defect or isn’t what was described: write to us and we’ll fix it or refund you. Anything applicable law requires also applies. We warn you before you download, in My purchases.

sections.title: What you get back
sections.body: The amount you actually paid, including any discount or coupon you used and the taxes you were charged. It goes back to the same payment method. Timing depends on Mercado Pago, your card or your bank.

sections.title: What happens to what you bought
items: Templates, bundle and builder: once the refund is approved, the license and downloads for that order are revoked, and you must stop using and delete the code.
LAB: when the first charge is refunded, the subscription ends right away and the plan goes back to free; sections published above the free limit stop showing.

sections.title: How to request it
items: From the Withdrawal request button (at the bottom of the home page): no account needed, with a tracking code right away. Works for any payment method.
If you paid by card (Paddle), you can also ask Paddle, our authorized reseller, directly at paddle.net.
Or write to us with your purchase email and order number (contact at the bottom of this page). We review it and reply as soon as possible.

sections.title: After the period
sections.body: Once the period has passed there is no change-of-mind refund, on any product. We still review any case where the file can’t be delivered, has a substantial technical defect, or applicable law requires otherwise: write to us.

sections.title: Free trial and cancellation (LAB)
sections.body: Your first subscription comes with a free trial: cancel before it ends and you pay nothing. You can cancel anytime from My account or LAB: canceling stops renewals and you keep access until the end of the period already paid, with no refund for that period.

sections.title: Studio (custom work)
sections.body: Custom work and Studio adaptations aren’t charged through the site checkout: they follow what’s agreed in the quote.

sections.title: Charges you don’t recognize
sections.body: If you see a charge you don’t recognize or have a problem with your purchase, write to us before asking your bank: we’ll sort it out quickly.
